block-guide:
CORE/MATH A displayed formula: the block keeps the LaTeX source in its comment and the formula as MathML in its HTML. Browsers draw MathML themselves; there is no script and no server render. The formula stands on its own line (display="block"), scrolling sideways when too wide. MARKUP (checked against the Gutenberg fixture)
a2+b2=c2a^2+b^2=c^2
Both halves are required: "latex" in the comment AND the MathML in . The page shows ONLY the saved MathML; latex alone shows nothing, and an empty latex saves nothing. Wrap the MathML in … and end with the holding the same LaTeX, as the editor does. In the comment JSON a backslash is doubled: "latex":"\\frac{1}{2}" (the editor writes \). Use mi (letters), mn (numbers), mo (operators), mfrac, msqrt, msup, msub, mrow. PITFALLS When the block is opened in the editor, the MathML is rebuilt from latex; if your MathML differs, the next save replaces it. Keep the two saying the same formula. MathML tags are allowed in content; script, style and event attributes are not. OPTIONS textColor, backgroundColor, fontSize (scales the formula), padding / margin, border: the classes and inline style go on the
. CHECK Open the page: the formula is drawn (fraction bars, exponents); reopen the editor: no "unexpected content" warning.
